Game Overview

Lollipop Stack Run puts players into a casual experience centered on embark on a sugary sprint in Lollipop Stack Run. Dash through candy realms, deftly avoiding obstacles while collecting lollipops to build towering, decorated delights. Customize your sweet stacks with charming themes and sell creations for coins. Race against friends, explore whimsical worlds, and revel in deliciously dynamic fun!
